Return mean sea level pressure given air temperature, elevation and station pressure.

Source: R/utils.R
get_mean_sea_level_pressure.Rd

Return mean sea level pressure given air temperature, elevation and station pressure.

Usage

get_mean_sea_level_pressure(prsttn, elevation, tmpair)

Arguments

elevation

A numeric vector of elevation in m

MET_prsttn

A numeric vector of observed station pressure in Pa

MET_tmpair

A numeric vector of air temperature in degC

Value

A numeric vector of mean sea level pressure in Pa

Note

The standard procedure for the US is to use for MET_tmpair the average of the current station temperature and the station temperature from 12 hours ago.

References

Hess SL, Introduction to theoretical meteorology, Holt Rinehart and Winston, NY 1959, ch. 6.5; Stull RB, Meteorology for scientists and engineers, 2nd edition, Brooks/Cole 2000, ch. 1.

get_mean_sea_level_pressure(101226.5, 105:205, 17.19)
